ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio with a predominantly low-intensity (dark) background (>90%) interspersed with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the tips and across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, contiguous high-intensity clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes; non-contiguous high-intensity linear and point-based markings distributed sparsely across the medial and lateral ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled V-shaped central depression with significant vertical depth relative to pixel width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing boundary with variable pixel-amplitudes; multiple distinct jagged indentations visible on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the leading edges, sweeping from the central peduncle attachment toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) at the distal extreme of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, thin high-intensity linear segments (rake marks) breaking the dark pigmentation across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distal tip barnacle clusters and widespread linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
